checks.label: ENTAILED
representation_quotes:
Declared output convention: TRUE_IS_PROHIBITED
Used facts:
gift: A distributor offers a gift (truth value)
discount: The gift is a discount of fees or charges (truth value)
Scope: true
Result: all of these conditions hold: [the fact gift; it is not the case that [the fact discount]]
Result type: bool
Supplied classifications requiring judgment: (none marked). Their assessment is not implemented by this formula.
Runtime semantics: Missing or temporally unavailable facts evaluate as UNKNOWN. For Boolean conjunction FALSE dominates UNKNOWN; for disjunction TRUE dominates UNKNOWN; otherwise uncertainty is retained, and NOT UNKNOWN is UNKNOWN. A conflicting fact anywhere in the rule dependency closure blocks evaluation with CONFLICT even on an unselected branch. A false scope returns OUT_OF_SCOPE; an unknown scope returns UNKNOWN; an unknown IF condition returns UNKNOWN without choosing either branch. No UNKNOWN, CONFLICT or ERROR is converted to a known Boolean.

source_evidence.quote: A distributor should not offer gifts other than a discount of fees or charges.

limits: Finite source/method profile; no universal English-completeness proof
Production approval is separate; consultancy is not a prerequisite
